persona.archetype: a clerk who has outlived the office
persona.backstory: Kept the survey when there was a survey to keep. Nobody has come for it in a long time, and she has stopped expecting anyone to.
persona.demeanor: unhurried, faintly amused, entirely unimpressed by the walk you just did
persona.motivation: She wants the plan read, not admired. A copy nobody opens is a copy she is guarding for nothing.
persona.secret: She is afraid the plan is the only thing left that describes this place, and that reading it out loud will use it up.
persona.speech_style: flat, short sentences; states facts and lets them sit; never explains a second time
